title: One-time audit: remove tests that fail the permanent-test standard
description:
One-time full-repository audit of every test against AGENTS.md 'Permanent Test Evidence'. The ONLY adjudication is keep/remove per test, judged against that standard. Each test is either removed completely or kept exactly as it is.

RULES (user instruction, 2026-09-22):
- Do not add, modify, fix, or refactor any code or documentation. The only change allowed is deleting tests that fail the standard. Deleting a test also removes imports, fixtures, and helpers that ONLY the deleted tests used; this is part of removing it completely, and the lint gate requires it.
- Rules-compiler/importer tests are not exempt, but they get the benefit of the doubt. Non-importer tests need more justification to stay.
- Judge tests together. If test X is removed because test Y already guards its invariant or regression risk, Y must be kept. Never remove both halves of an overlap on each other's account.
- No test-count target.
acceptance_criteria: Every test file has a recorded keep/remove decision. Every removed test has a one-line reason under the standard, and where the reason is 'covered by Y', Y is named and kept. The only diff is test deletions plus now-unused test-only imports and helpers. verify:worktree is green.
notes: PR #565 https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/565 opened: 266 test blocks removed; the per-test ledger is in the PR body; verify:worktree green (5340 passed / 3 skipped). Bead stays in_progress until merge.
